G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: No matching entity on the Texas list of active franchise taxpayers. Texas does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to pay franchise tax, and an exempt entity is left off as well, so this is a check this source cannot complete rather than evidence against the firm. The state's own SOSDirect service can settle it for a fee

faq.q: How much does Strauch Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Strauch Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Strauch Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Strauch Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Strauch Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Strauch Law Firm publishes one office, in San Antonio. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Strauch Law Firm?
faq.a: Strauch Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
